data.title: 0.7.0 stays on kadence/v1: a default changed, no field was removed from the schema
data.why: Three defaults changed - task list stopped carrying history, list commands return a page of 100, prime caps free text at 2000 characters - and the stability rule says a field may be added within kadence/v1 and never renamed or removed. None was. The schema has always placed history under task show; task list emitted it anyway, so removing it there makes the emission match the promise rather than breaking one. A default is not a field: a caller who needs the old answer passes a flag, and the changelog names the flag for each of the three. Bumping to kadence/v2 would tell every agent that everything it knows is suspect, to describe three changes that each have a one-flag remedy.
data.rejected: kadence/v2: it is the honest label if you count history as a removal, but it costs every agent a re-read of the whole schema to communicate three narrow changes.; Calling 0.7.0 a patch: three changed defaults are not a patch, whatever the size of the diff.
